summary: Verified contact-form recipient routing via Site Settings with monkey-patched resend.Emails.send. 59/60 pytest PASS across full backend suite. The main spec (to_override kwarg, admin-editable SiteSettings.email used as primary recipient, ADMIN_EMAIL env fallback, submission always persisted, endpoint never surfaces 500) is fully working end-to-end. One minor edge-case bug found: a SiteSettings.email value composed entirely of whitespace is not falling back to ADMIN_EMAIL — send_contact_email raises RuntimeError instead. Because the endpoint wraps in try/except, the client still gets 200 and the row is persisted, so user-facing behaviour is intact; only the admin-email fallback promise is broken for the whitespace case.

minor.issue: Whitespace-only to_override (e.g. site.email='   ') does NOT fall back to ADMIN_EMAIL. `recipient = (to_override or ADMIN_EMAIL or '').strip()` picks the truthy whitespace string, strips to empty, and raises RuntimeError. Spec says: 'If SiteSettings.email is empty/whitespace, the handler must fall back to ADMIN_EMAIL'. User is unaffected (endpoint still returns 200 and persists submission) but the fallback email is never sent.

action_items: Fix whitespace fallback in email_service.py line 71. Suggested: `_override = (to_override or '').strip(); recipient = _override or (ADMIN_EMAIL or '').strip()`. Alternatively, fix at source in contact_routes.py: `recipient = site.email.strip() if site and site.email and site.email.strip() else None`.
Optional: strip/normalise settings.email server-side in PUT /api/admin/settings so whitespace never persists (defence-in-depth).
critical_code_review_comments: email_service.py:71 — `(to_override or ADMIN_EMAIL or '').strip()` has the whitespace-fallback hole described above; non-blocking but violates the spec for the whitespace case.

contact_routes.py:80 — `recipient = (site.email if site and site.email else None)` passes through whitespace-only values untouched; combined with the email_service line this causes the only failing spec test. Should also `.strip()` here.
contact_routes.py correctly wraps send_contact_email in try/except and always returns 200 with the DB row persisted — invariant test_persists_when_resend_raises confirms this.
Verified via monkey-patch that params['to'] captures the live SiteSettings value (lab-test@iwm-lab.ca used in the in-process test, matching the manual curl repro in the review note).
No regressions observed across auth, team (incl. facebook rename), gallery (image+embed), publications (both-source rules), settings, file proxy, rate-limit, or contact-form baseline suites.

success_rate.backend: 98% (59/60 pytest). Routing spec + persistence invariant + None/empty fallback + RuntimeError-when-both-empty all PASS. Only the whitespace-only fallback edge case fails.

seed_data_creation: Contact submissions with prefix TEST_Routing_* inserted via POST /api/contact during routing tests (6 rows). SiteSettings.email toggled between 'lab-test@iwm-lab.ca', 'first-routed@iwm-lab.ca', 'second-routed@iwm-lab.ca', '' — restored to 'contact@iwm-lab.ca' at module teardown (verified via GET /api/settings).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Tests use FastAPI TestClient in-process (pytest from /app/backend with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL exported) so resend.Emails.send can be monkey-patched and params['to'] inspected. When re-running, ensure REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is in env: `export REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=$(grep REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL /app/frontend/.env | cut -d= -f2 | tr -d '"')`. After the whitespace-fallback fix, the single failing test `TestSendContactEmailUnit::test_fallback_when_override_is_empty_or_whitespace` should pass without modification. SiteSettings is a singleton row (id=1) — always restore email to 'contact@iwm-lab.ca' on teardown.
rca of the issue: RCA of whitespace-fallback bug — Reproduction: (1) PUT /api/admin/settings with json={'email':'   '} (Note: currently accepted as-is by the API). (2) POST /api/contact. Expected: Resend called with ADMIN_EMAIL. Actual: email_service raises RuntimeError('No contact recipient configured') and caller swallows it; no email is sent. Root cause: in email_service.py line 71, `(to_override or ADMIN_EMAIL or '').strip()` evaluates `to_override` for Python truthiness BEFORE stripping — a non-empty whitespace string is truthy, so `or ADMIN_EMAIL` is never evaluated; the subsequent `.strip()` then collapses it to ''. Mitigation: strip to_override first, THEN short-circuit: `override = (to_override or '').strip(); recipient = override or (ADMIN_EMAIL or '').strip()`. Impact: low — endpoint still returns 200 and submission is persisted; only the fallback delivery is lost. No data corruption.
